posts.preview: This morning, I joined my constituency—the workers—and the Namibia National Teachers Union (NANTU) at the Oshana Regional Annual Teachers Sports Tournament, held at Oshakati Sports Stadium under the theme: “NANTU Building Bonds Through Sports.”
The event is officiated by Hon. Dino Ballotti, Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Education, Innovation, Youth, Arts and Culture (MEYAIC), who also serves as the patron of the tournament See less
